captures.name: frowning-shrink
captures.findings: Small upright silhouette grounded with a reduced shadow; facial/wake detail is difficult to distinguish at this size.

captures.name: gaper-shrink
captures.findings: Entire upright model is reduced, with no full-sized detached head or shadow. This isolated actor remains visible against open sand.

captures.name: gusher-shrink
captures.findings: Small headless body and red neck spray remain visible. Existing ground blood trail remains separate and is not retroactively scaled.

captures.name: pacer-shrink
captures.findings: Small headless body and arms remain visible with no Gusher neck spray. Fine detail is weak at this size.

captures.name: horf-shrink
captures.findings: Small pale skull sits at ground level with a reduced shadow; no new aimed shot is visible or reported.

captures.name: horf-recovered
captures.findings: Skull is approaching normal size again; aimed projectile, its shadow and warning line are visible. Probe reports zero Shrink and scale0.935568.

captures.name: horf-squashed
captures.findings: Actor removed at player contact; HUD/probe show zero threats and player remains at100HP. This still is not an animation-quality certification.

limitations: Single open-room fixtures at one zoom/angle; crowded, occluded and varied-zoom acceptance remains open. Tiny facial details are intentionally reduced and hard to distinguish.
Thirty-frame native smoke captures establish appearance and probe state, not controlled rendered performance. The9FPS readout is not a benchmark.
Status clocks/transition and contact death are tested separately. Still images do not certify animation quality or full encounter balance. No player item granting Shrink was added.
